tips: Focus on comprehensive country documentaries (pk_country) and student migration listicles (pk_best_list), as long-form educational content holds significantly higher page average (0.82 vs 0.54).
Use direct country comparison hooks (pk_versus_short) like 'Canada vs Australia', which generated up to 9.69x performance.
Always use Urdu script for hooks and titles instead of Roman Urdu transliteration (Urdu title hit 5.9k views while the exact Roman Urdu version got only 31 views).
Completely eliminate food culture content (pk_food) and short salary breakdowns (pk_salary_short, pk_cost_short), which both averaged below 0.42x.
Avoid generic tourist or historical overviews (e.g., Baku tours, Dubai history) in favor of high-impact facts and actionable settlement insights.
